strings.window.title: Prosperous Alchemist
strings.stale.noticeWithReason: Notice: Potion list may be outdated ({reason}).
strings.stale.notice: Notice: Potion list may be outdated.
strings.pagination.finalizing: Finalizing potion list... Loading page data
strings.pagination.noSearchResults: No recipes match the search filter
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.saved: Changes are saved to alchemist.ini automatically.
strings.settings.usePlayerStatsDescription: Includes Alchemy skill, perks, and worn Fortify Alchemy equipment.
strings.settings.singleThreadedDescription: Disable this option to use the multithreaded calculation path.
strings.settings.cacheDurationDescription: How long to keep master recipe cache in memory after closing the alchemy menu (default 180s).
strings.settings.staleThresholdDescription: If calculation took longer than this, defer recalculations during crafting and show manual Recalculate button (default 500ms).
strings.settings.debounceDescription: Delay before running background recalculation after rapid crafting clicks (default 400ms).
strings.settings.filterSelectedDescription: Show only potions made from ingredients currently selected in the Skyrim alchemy menu. With no ingredients selected, all potions are shown.
strings.settings.prefixDescription: Prefixes are applied to beneficial potion and harmful poison names.
strings.tracking.refreshDescription: Rebuilds automatic requirements from currently loaded quest objectives, constructible records, and selected ingredient effects. Use it after a quest objective changes or new records are loaded; manual tracking rows and saved overrides are not removed.
strings.tracking.resetDescription: Deletes manually added tracking rows and all saved overrides on automatic rows, then rescans currently loaded data. Custom protected ingredients and selected protected effects are not changed. Use it when you want every detected row to return to its current automatic values.
strings.tracking.title: Ingredient protection and tracking
strings.tracking.enabled: Tracking protection is enabled in this window.
strings.tracking.disabled: Tracking protection is disabled in this window.
strings.tracking.description: All loaded quests are listed below, including future inactive quests. Quest matching uses objective text, so verify detected ingredient rows and edit or mark them complete when needed.
strings.tracking.questCompletionNotice: Completed quests are automatically marked complete and excluded from the protected ingredient list.
strings.tracking.enableProtectionDescription: Static reservations, craftable-item requirements, selected effects, and unfinished tracking requirements are used while this is enabled.
strings.tracking.manualProtectionOnly: Use only manual/custom protection (keep protected effects)
strings.tracking.manualProtectionOnlyDescription: Disable automatic quest and craftable reservations. Selected protected effects remain active and visible.
strings.tracking.effectsDescription: Select effects to reserve every ingredient that provides them. Set each selected effect to protect all copies or a finite quantity per ingredient; open an ingredient below to adjust an individual detection.
strings.tracking.noEffects: No ingredient effects are available from loaded records.
strings.tracking.noAvailableEffects: All available effects are already protected.
strings.tracking.manualOverrideDescription: Clears manual completion overrides only. This resets automatic rows whose Completed checkbox you changed, including user-marked complete rows, to their current automatically detected source, ingredient, quantity, and completion state. It does not clear automatic detections, manually added tracking rows, or custom protected ingredients.
strings.tracking.noAvailableIngredients: No available ingredients match the search.
strings.tracking.protectionSummaryText: {count} ingredients have active protection requirements or manual overrides.
strings.tracking.noProtectionComparison: No detected ingredients or protected-list entries to compare.
strings.tracking.detectionSearchHint: Filter detected requirements, ingredients, and quests...
strings.tracking.detectedSummary: {detected} detected rows, {active} unfinished rows currently contribute to protection.
strings.tracking.atronachForgeLocation: Location: The Midden, beneath the College of Winterhold.
strings.tracking.atronachForgeDirections: In-game, enter the College of Winterhold and use the trapdoor to The Midden, then follow the tunnels to the forge chamber.
strings.tracking.atronachForgeSource: Recipe detection comes from loaded constructible records whose crafting keyword identifies the Atronach Forge.
strings.tracking.detectedQuestSummary: {count} quests have unfinished or overridden ingredient matches.
strings.tracking.noDetectedQuests: No quest objectives currently match a loaded ingredient.
strings.tracking.questSummary: {count} quests loaded; informational rows do not protect ingredients by themselves.
strings.tracking.noQuests: No quest records are currently available from the game.
strings.tracking.noQuestMatches: No loaded quests match the search filter.
strings.tracking.noObjectives: No objectives are present in this quest record.
strings.tracking.sourceDescription: Quest, activity, station, or any other reason to reserve the ingredient.
strings.tracking.none: No detected or manual requirements are currently tracked.
strings.tracking.noSelectedQuest: Select a loaded quest above to inspect stages and control objectives.
strings.tracking.noStages: No stage data is available for this quest record.
strings.tracking.stageWarning: Stage regressions and stopped quests require Force; make a hard save before changing quest state.
strings.tracking.ingredientDetailsDescription: This popup shows every protection source for this ingredient. Changes are saved immediately and reduce the copies available to the potion calculator.
strings.tracking.staticProtectionDescription: Static protection is a manual reservation for this ingredient. It applies independently of detected quests, recipes, and selected effects.
strings.tracking.noStaticProtection: This ingredient has no static protection exception.
strings.tracking.addStaticProtectionDescription: Use this button to add a saved reservation before changing its quantity.
strings.tracking.protectAllStaticDescription: When checked, reserve every copy currently available. When unchecked, reserve only the finite quantity entered below.
strings.tracking.staticQuantityDescription: This is the number of copies reserved by the static protection entry; increasing it leaves fewer copies available for crafting.
strings.tracking.removeStaticProtectionDescripti: Remove the saved static reservation when this ingredient no longer needs a manual hold.
strings.tracking.detectedSourcesDescription: These rows were found from loaded game records or entered as tracking requirements. Each row contributes its own reservation, and all unfinished rows are combined for this ingredient.
strings.tracking.protectAllDetectionDescription: Reserve every available copy for this source. Clear it to use a finite protected quantity instead.
strings.tracking.protectQuantityDescription: The protected quantity for this source is combined with other active sources for the same ingredient.
strings.tracking.completedDescription: Mark this requirement completed when it is fulfilled. Completed rows no longer reserve ingredient copies.
strings.tracking.removeDetectionDescription: Remove deletes this manual tracking row and its reservation; automatically detected rows cannot be removed here.
strings.tracking.noIngredientDetections: No automatic or manual detections currently reference this ingredient.
